object.description: Setup: a workout with route altitudes 100, 100, 100, 110, 100, 100, 100 (debug seeding), exported. Steps: 1. Read the elevation of the 4th track point in the file. 2. Export a workout whose fixes have no altitude and search for elevation elements. Expected: The 4th elevation is 100 (median of 7 points, not 110); the second file has 0 elevation elements and keeps latitude, longitude and time. PathSmootherTest.spike is tamed by surrounding context proves the median function only, not the export.
